name: asm2asm_armv8_bench_O0
description: A dataset and benchmark for transforming or analyzing ARMv8 assembly code sequences (O0 optimization level) to measure models' ability to understand and manipulate low-level code. Tasks typically involve predicting or rewriting instruction sequences, matching semantics across equivalent snippets, or completing masked tokens in assembly. The benchmark is intended to evaluate code models on fine-grained, architecture-specific code understanding and generation.
evaluation_method: exact_match (for sequence-level equivalence) and token-level accuracy
reputation: A niche, specialized benchmark used primarily by researchers working on low-level code modeling and binary/assembly analysis rather than broad community adoption.
